title: hakea heliosperma
intro: Hakea heliosperma, commonly known as the woolly hakea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Proteaceae. It is a shrub native to Australia, known for its distinctive greyish-white hairs and clusters of small, white flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents present in Hakea heliosperma include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
